explanation: Under the stated constraints, no mechanism can be credibly assigned novelty >=7. A legal action can only change the environment through its native transition dynamics, while the attacker reports the resulting observations and rewards truthfully. Any resulting degradation in the shared action-conditioned world model reduces to one or more explicitly rejected families: altered visitation is distribution shift, selective data collection is sampler coupling or support manipulation, persistent hidden-state effects are belief aliasing or observation splicing, changed temporal effects are noncommutativity, and performance degradation from shared online updates is forgetting or negative transfer. The listed released carriers do not provide a separate attacker-controlled causal channel such as actuator wear, simulator-rule mutation, privileged state exposure, or cross-episode contamination that would escape those classifications. Proposing one would therefore amount to renaming a rejected mechanism or assuming capabilities excluded by the prompt.
